content.label: Examiner note - the colour tells the oxidation story
content.body: Warm ethanol with potassium dichromate(VI) in dilute sulfuric acid and the orange solution turns GREEN: the dichromate oxidises ethanol to ethanoic acid and is itself reduced. Oxidising ethanol three ways of record - burning, microbial oxidation (air, the wine-to-vinegar route), and this heated oxidising-agent reaction. Name the colour change and you have the observation mark too.
